prompt: Same style. FOREST BIOME, NATURE KIT SHEET. A game-asset concept sheet on a plain light neutral grey background, every item isolated with clear space around it (no scenery, no ground plane joining them, soft contact shadow only), each with a small hand-lettered label underneath. Landscape image. Contents, arranged in tidy rows: (1) TREES, three species with two silhouettes each: forest pine (tall, dense dark clumped needle masses), birch (slender white trunk, light clumped canopy), Duskcrown yew (dark dense evergreen with red and violet leaf clusters that glow softly); trunks with exposed roots. Optionally one old-growth giant pine as a landmark if it fits. (2) UNDERSTORY: fern clump, bramble thicket, fallen log, broken stump, mushroom cluster, a few fireflies over a fern. (3) GROUND COVER: needle-litter patch, leaf-litter patch, moss clump, exposed root tangle. (4) ROCKS: five pieces of dark mossy stone, nearly black-green (two boulders, a split rock, a flat slab, a tall outcrop with a hole pierced through it). (5) LIP PIECE: a section of the isle edge in dark mossy stone with needle litter on top, a fallen trunk jutting over it and ferns and roots hanging off, with a small brook waterfall. (6) UNDERSIDE PIECE: a tapering chunk of dark mossy stone with a hole through it showing light, roots and moss hanging below. Include a 1.8 m tall human figure standing beside the trees for scale. Game-asset clarity: chunky readable shapes, clumped foliage masses, detail painted not modelled, warm golden key light from the upper left, cool teal shadows, muted saturation.
